sub_maxims: Make your contribution as informative as is required for the current purposes of exchange.
Do not make your contribution more informative than is required.
maxim_of_quantity.flouting_implicature: Giving scant details implies speaker lacks knowledge or withholds intentionally

maxim_of_quality.super_maxim: Try to make your contribution one that is true.
sub_maxims: Do not say what you believe to be false.
Do not say that for which you lack adequate evidence.
maxim_of_quality.flouting_implicature: Irony, sarcasm, hyperbole, and metaphor arise from blatant violation of Quality

maxim_of_relation.flouting_implicature: Abrupt topic change implies discomfort with previous subject or implicit refusal
